title: Summoning Wand
body:
# Summoning Wand
This simple mod adds a wand for teleporting entities to your location, which works like `/tp` command. ## Features * **Item Name:** Summoning Wand * **Item ID:** `summoningwand:summoning_wand` * **Creative Tab:** Tools & Utilities * **Crafting Recipe:**
* **Usage:** Press `Shift` to show brief usage guide when hovering your mouse over the summoning wand item in your inventory. * **Supported Entities:** Most mobs (even including players, though disabled by default), vehicles and other entities supporting interaction (such as falling blocks). > Normally, the entity types above also includes entities from other mods, like assembled minecarts (*[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)*), aircraft (*[Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)*) and fake players (*[Curtain](https://modrinth.com/mod/curtain)*). * **Configurations:** You can set what kinds of entities can/can't be bound, what kinds of blocks you can/can't teleport entities to and many other options in configuration files. > `/summoningwand` command is provided for hot updating the configurations manually as a substitute for the auto-reload system of Forge (which seems not so reliable). For more detailed information, please refer to the repository pages: [GitHub](https://github.com/Xyc1596/SummoningWand) ## Notes This is my first Minecraft mod and a learning project for Forge/NeoForge development.
Submit an [issue](https://github.com/Xyc1596/SummoningWand/issues) if you find bugs or have suggestions.
